subject: general
question: As per the newly released Surrogacy Rules 2022, surrogacy couples must purchase health insurance coverage for the surrogate mother for a period of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**three years.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the newly released **Surrogacy Rules 2022**, surrogacy couples must purchase health insurance coverage for the surrogate mother for a period of** three years.**
 
• The objective of this rule is to ensure the** health and well-being** of the surrogate mother during and after the pregnancy.
 
• It will also provide** financial security **to the surrogate mother in case of any medical emergencies or complications.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The period of **three years** is considered adequate for **surrogacy.**
 
• It is imperative to ensure that the surrogate mother is covered for a **sufficient period **to avoid any potential health risks or complications.
 
• Surrogacy is an arrangement where a **woman carries and delivers a child **for another couple or person.
 
• It is a **complex legal and ethical issue** that involves various medical, social, and emotional aspects.
 
• The **Surrogacy Rules 2022** aims to regulate and streamline the surrogacy process in India.
